messages:
ashley: quick async standup from late shift — what I did / blockers / today

ashley: did an emergency rebalance of spot-backed lanes in eu-west-3 after eviction spike at 22:10 UTC; moved two hottest models to on-demand pool to avoid tail latency for live customers. observed NVLink saturation on node-gpu-17, left a note in the node ticket. :warning:

ashley: blocker — some instances came up with old driver (520.x) unexpectedly; I'm patching a daemonset to enforce 525.85 tomorrow. need someone to sign off on rolling the driver bump across ams1 next maintenance window. @raj?

raj: saw the driver mismatch in the logs — thanks for catching. I'm on call for ams1 maintenance window on Friday. happy to approve the bump after a quick smoke test in the canary pool. :+1:

raj: also, small ask — can we hold one spare on-demand GPU in ams1 for a hot spare during the driver rollout? saves a rollback if the kernel module acts up.

ashley: yes, I'll allocate a 1-GPU reserve in the config. updating the infra config now: `reserve_gpus: 1` for ams1.

marta: FYI I finished PR #4217 (fleet autoscaler: prefer underutilized AZs) — needs one more review. This change should help rebalance without manual intervention. Planning to merge after the driver bump goes in production.

tim: quick heads-up — noticed a regression in prefix cache hit-rate for the quantized-8 models after the last optimizer patch. Putting a short test harness in CI to compare token throughput; will post results in the morning.

ashley: thanks @tim — that could explain extra load on the on-demand pool. If the cache hit-rate drops we should consider temporarily increasing batch windows for that model family until we get numbers.

raj: infra-bot triggered an alert earlier about low quota for `nvidia-a100-40gb` in ap-south-1 — opened ticket INF-3312 with cloud provider. ETA on quota bump currently 48–72h.

ashley: noted. can we shift scheduled experiments from ap-south-1 to ap-southeast-1 for the next 24–48h? I can update the experiment runner to prefer a-region tag.

marta: yep I'll add a small fallback in the experiments scheduler. patch will prefer `region_preference: [ap-southeast-1, ap-south-1]`.

tim: small troubleshooting snippet I used to confirm driver versions on nodes:
```
kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.status.nodeInfo.kernelVersion}
{end}' | grep gpu
```

ashley: thanks, adding that to the runbook.

raj: final note — please leave status updates in INF-3312 when you reallocate or change reservation flags so on-call has the history.

ashley: will do. closing loop — I'll merge the temporary on-demand reserve change, tag @raj for Friday sign-off, and monitor the quantized-8 cache numbers overnight. ping me if anything spikes. :sleeping:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for "reserve-config-amend" succeeded in eu-west-3 at 23:05 UTC. No errors.

marta: nice, thanks everyone.

tim: good night folks — will post CI numbers in the morning.

ashley: good night — appreciate the quick responses.
